title: Gateway sender-store exhausted-flag arms have zero test coverage
description: Found by correctness codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-lynw. rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs: all sender-store test states use exhausted: false. The exhaustion-regression rejection in sender_state_precedes (state (exhausted: false, low seq) vs floor (MAX, exhausted: true) must be Err(Corrupt), :253) and the terminal heal (floor := (MAX, true)) are logically verified correct by review but exercised by no test. Review confirmed the dangerous incomparable input is unproducible with current callers (exhausted implies next_sequence == u64::MAX, oscore lib.rs:655-663, validated at context.rs:322-324), but the exhausted flag is load-bearing for floor ordering and deserves a small test per the repo test-vector discipline. Fix: add a test that (a) loads a floor (MAX, exhausted) against a restored non-exhausted lower-seq state record and asserts Err(Corrupt), and (b) exercises the heal arm with a terminal (MAX, exhausted) state.
